title: Agentic Physics-Grounded Video Generation via Memory-Augmented In-Context Reasoning
title_zh: 基于记忆增强上下文推理的智能体物理接地视频生成

paragraphs.en: Physical plausibility is essential for realistic video generation. Existing methods impose physical guidance before synthesis via simulations or refined prompts, but this can limit dynamic diversity, miss errors that emerge only after generation, and require repeated regeneration when inconsistencies remain. We therefore study a generate–diagnose–repair paradigm that preserves the original generation capability and selectively repairs physical inconsistencies afterward, raising two key questions: what to repair and how to repair? To address them, we introduce PhysRepair , an agentic video generation framework that combines causal reasoning over the observed physical failure with prior repair experience to enable localized and adaptive correction. Specifically, Spatiotemporal Causal Constraints identify the first invalid physical state and its causally affected states, producing a repair specification that guides physically plausible local regeneration while preserving unaffected content. Experience-augmented In-context Learning combines the ongoing repair context with relevant experience from previous repairs, allowing the agent to adapt its repair decisions across diverse physical failures and accumulate completed trajectories for future cases. Experiments on Physics-IQ Verified across solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, optics, thermodynamics, and magnetism demonstrate that PhysRepair consistently improves the physical plausibility of generated videos over existing methods. Our project page is available at https://xxkkxxx.github.io/PhysRepair-Website/ .

paragraphs.en: Modern video generators achieve impressive visual quality but still struggle with physical plausibility, often producing implausible motion, incorrect contact or collision behavior, and unrealistic responses to physical forces ( Bansal et al., 2024 ; Bansal et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . Existing approaches to physically plausible video generation primarily seek to prevent physical failures during synthesis by incorporating physical knowledge through training data, motion priors, simulation, or iteratively refined physical prompts ( Liu et al., 2024 ; Xue et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Nguyen et al., 2026 ) . However, imposing extensive physical guidance before synthesis can constrain the model’s ability to generate diverse and complex dynamics, favoring simpler and predefined physical interactions. In contrast, we follow a generate–diagnose–repair paradigm that preserves the generator’s original synthesis capability and introduces physical guidance only after specific inconsistencies are observed, enabling localized correction of the affected interactions while leaving already-valid content unchanged, as shown in Fig. 1 . This formulation raises two coupled challenges: 1) What to repair. A spatial mask can localize an object, but cannot determine which temporal states should change, whether another object’s trajectory should be preserved, or how a physical failure propagates across objects, space, and time ( Yi et al., 2020 ; Motamed et al., 2026 ) ; 2) How to repair. Diverse physical failures require different physical evidence, simulation configurations, and generation conditions that cannot be predefined for every case, while overly broad corrections may disrupt already-valid interactions and dynamics and introduce new inconsistencies ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现代视频生成器已经能够实现令人印象深刻的视觉质量，但在物理合理性方面仍然存在困难，常常生成不合常理的运动、错误的接触或碰撞行为，以及对物理力不真实的响应（Bansal et al., 2024; Bansal et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2025）。 现有的物理合理视频生成方法主要致力于在合成过程中防止物理失败，其途径是通过训练数据、运动先验、仿真或迭代精炼的物理提示来融入物理知识（Liu et al., 2024; Xue et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2025; Nguyen et al., 2026）。 然而，在合成之前施加大量的物理引导会限制模型生成多样且复杂动态的能力，使其偏向更简单且预先定义的物理交互。 相比之下，我们遵循一种“生成—诊断—修复”范式，该范式保留了生成器原有的合成能力，并只在观察到特定不一致性之后才引入物理引导，从而能够对受影响的交互进行局部修正，同时保持已经正确的内容不变，如图 1 所示。 这一设定带来了两个相互关联的挑战：1）修复什么。 空间掩码可以定位一个物体，但无法确定哪些时间状态应当改变、另一个物体的轨迹是否应当保留，以及物理失败如何在物体、空间和时间之间传播（Yi et al., 2020; Motamed et al., 2026）；2）如何修复。 多种多样的物理失败需要不同的物理证据、仿真配置和生成条件，而这些无法为每一种情况预先定义，同时过于宽泛的修正可能会破坏已经正确的交互与动态，并引入新的不一致性（Shinn et al., 2023; Xu et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we cast physical video repair as an adaptive agentic process : the agent reasons about the causal influence of an observed physical failure to localize the repair to the affected content, while drawing on prior repair processes of related physical failures to determine how the repair should be performed. This enables targeted and adaptive correction without globally modifying already-valid dynamics or solving each failure from scratch. By iteratively diagnosing repaired results and refining subsequent interventions, the agent progressively improves the physical plausibility of the generated video.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们将物理视频修复转化为一个自适应的智能体过程：智能体通过推理所观测到的物理失效的因果影响，将修复定位到受影响的内容，同时借鉴相关物理失效的既有修复过程，以确定修复应如何执行。 这使得系统能够进行有针对性和自适应的纠正，而无需全局修改已经正确的动态，也无需从零开始解决每一个失效。 通过迭代式地诊断修复结果并优化后续干预，智能体逐步提升所生成视频的物理合理性。

paragraphs.en: Concretely, we introduce PhysRepair , an agentic video generation system that operationalizes this adaptive repair process through Spatiotemporal Causal Constraints and Experience-augmented In-context Learning . For Spatiotemporal Causal Constraints, we organize the diagnosed interaction into an object-centric causal representation, locate the first physically invalid state, and trace its downstream effects to construct a causal repair specification. The specification is then used to reconstruct a physically plausible alternative to the incorrect dynamics and guide localized video regeneration while suppressing conflicting source dynamics. Experience-augmented In-context Learning maintains the evolving repair process in short-term working memory and augments it with relevant repair experience retrieved from long-term experience memory. Together, they provide in-context guidance to adapt agentic repair decisions, while completed trajectories are distilled back into the long-term experience memory for future repairs.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，我们提出了 PhysRepair，一个智能体化视频生成系统，通过时空因果约束与经验增强的上下文学习来实现这一自适应修复流程。 对于时空因果约束，我们将诊断出的交互组织为以对象为中心的因果表示，定位第一个物理无效状态，并追踪其下游影响以构建因果修复规范。 随后，该规范被用于重构物理上合理的替代动态以取代错误的动态，并引导局部化的视频再生成，同时抑制相互冲突的源动态。 经验增强的上下文学习将不断演化的修复过程维护在短期工作记忆中，并通过从长期经验记忆中检索到的相关修复经验对其进行增强。 二者共同提供上下文指导以调整智能体化修复决策，同时已完成的修复轨迹会被蒸馏回长期经验记忆，以供未来的修复使用。

paragraphs.en: Recent benchmarks reveal that video generators often fail to satisfy physical laws, even when they achieve high photorealism and temporal smoothness. VideoPhy and PhyGenBench evaluate physical common sense across solid, fluid, and multi-domain phenomena ( Bansal et al., 2024 ; Meng et al., 2024 ) . Physics-IQ tests whether models can predict physically valid futures from observed experimental frames ( Motamed et al., 2025 ) . Meanwhile, VideoPhy-2 and T2VPhysBench evaluate fine-grained rule adherence and first-principles conservation laws ( Bansal et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . Together, these studies highlight the need to explicitly assess contacts, trajectories, and transitions, which directly provides candidate failure categories for our verifier. Beyond evaluation, another line of work injects physical guidance prior to video synthesis. For example, PhysGen renders rigid-body simulations via diffusion priors ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . PhyT2V iteratively refines text prompts using physical rules ( Xue et al., 2025 ) . Similarly, VLIPP plans coarse trajectories ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and PhysPlan optimizes motion updates away from passive regions via agentic planning ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) . However, imposing extensive physical constraints before synthesis restricts the diversity of generated dynamics, cannot address physical errors that only appear post-generation, and often requires costly global regeneration. In contrast, our generate–diagnose–repair paradigm preserves the base model’s generative capacity. We introduce physical guidance only after detecting specific inconsistencies, enabling localized corrections while keeping already-valid content intact.
paragraphs.zh: 近期基准测试表明，即使视频生成器达到了高度的真实感和时间平滑性，也常常无法满足物理定律。 VideoPhy 和 PhyGenBench 跨固体、流体和多领域现象评估物理常识（Bansal et al., 2024; Meng et al., 2024）。 Physics-IQ 测试模型能否从观测到的实验帧中预测物理上有效的未来（Motamed et al., 2025）。 与此同时，VideoPhy-2 和 T2VPhysBench 评估细粒度的规则遵循和第一性原理守恒定律（Bansal et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2025）。 这些研究共同凸显了显式评估接触、轨迹和过渡状态的必要性，这直接为我们的验证器提供了候选失败类别。 除评估之外，另一条研究路线在视频合成之前注入物理引导。 例如，PhysGen 通过扩散先验渲染刚体仿真（Liu et al., 2024）。 PhyT2V 利用物理规则迭代地细化文本提示（Xue et al., 2025）。 类似地，VLIPP 规划粗粒度轨迹（Yang et al., 2025），PhysPlan 通过智能体规划优化运动更新，使其远离被动区域（Nguyen et al., 2026）。 然而，在合成之前施加大量物理约束会限制生成动力学的多样性，无法解决仅在生成之后才出现的物理错误，并且通常需要代价高昂的全局重新生成。 相比之下，我们的「生成—诊断—修复」范式保留了基础模型的生成能力。 我们只在检测到特定不一致之后才引入物理引导，从而在保持已经有效的内容不变的同时实现局部修正。

sents.en: Recent benchmarks reveal that video generators often fail to satisfy physical laws, even when they achieve high photorealism and temporal smoothness.

sents.en: Physics-IQ tests whether models can predict physically valid futures from observed experimental frames ( Motamed et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: Physics-IQ 测试模型能否从观测到的实验帧中预测物理上有效的未来（Motamed et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Meanwhile, VideoPhy-2 and T2VPhysBench evaluate fine-grained rule adherence and first-principles conservation laws ( Bansal et al., 2025 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) .

sents.en: Together, these studies highlight the need to explicitly assess contacts, trajectories, and transitions, which directly provides candidate failure categories for our verifier.

sents.en: Beyond evaluation, another line of work injects physical guidance prior to video synthesis.

sents.en: For example, PhysGen renders rigid-body simulations via diffusion priors ( Liu et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: 例如，PhysGen 通过扩散先验渲染刚体仿真（Liu et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Similarly, VLIPP plans coarse trajectories ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and PhysPlan optimizes motion updates away from passive regions via agentic planning ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 类似地，VLIPP 规划粗粒度轨迹（Yang et al., 2025），PhysPlan 通过智能体规划优化运动更新，使其远离被动区域（Nguyen et al., 2026）。

sents.en: However, imposing extensive physical constraints before synthesis restricts the diversity of generated dynamics, cannot address physical errors that only appear post-generation, and often requires costly global regeneration.
sents.zh: 然而，在合成之前施加大量物理约束会限制生成动力学的多样性，无法解决仅在生成之后才出现的物理错误，并且通常需要代价高昂的全局重新生成。

sents.en: In contrast, our generate–diagnose–repair paradigm preserves the base model’s generative capacity.

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for physical planning and output evaluation. Beyond pre-generation planning ( Xue et al., 2025 ; Nguyen et al., 2026 ) , VeriPhy translates prompts into explicit physical rules, collects tool-based evidence, and verifies outcomes before rewriting prompts ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . These systems demonstrate the value of verification feedback, but primarily use it to revise prompts for global regeneration rather than guide localized repair. Moving from global regeneration to localized repair requires not only identifying physical failures but also selecting intervention strategies suited to each case. To support such adaptive decision-making, frameworks such as Reflexion and Voyager offer a useful precedent: they reuse feedback and accumulated experience to guide subsequent actions without updating model weights ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2023 ) , providing a basis for experience-driven in-context learning (ICL). Building on this principle, our Experience-Augmented In-Context Learning combines current repair feedback with relevant prior repair experience in the agent’s context, enabling adaptive repair decisions without solving each failure from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）越来越多地被用于物理规划与输出评估。 除了生成前规划（Xue et al., 2025；Nguyen et al., 2026）之外，VeriPhy 将提示词转化为显式的物理规则，收集基于工具的证据，并在重写提示词之前验证结果（Xu et al., 2026）。 这些系统展示了验证反馈的价值，但主要是用它来修改提示词以进行全局重新生成，而不是指导局部修复。 从全局重新生成转向局部修复，不仅需要识别物理失效，还需要为每种情况选择合适的干预策略。 为支持这种自适应决策，Reflexion 和 Voyager 等框架提供了有益的先例：它们在不更新模型权重的情况下复用反馈和积累的经验来指导后续行动（Shinn et al., 2023；Wang et al., 2023），为经验驱动的上下文学习（ICL）提供了基础。 基于这一原则，我们的经验增强上下文学习将当前修复反馈与相关的先前修复经验结合到智能体的上下文中，从而无需从零开始解决每个失效即可实现自适应修复决策。

sents.en: A successful repair is accepted; otherwise, the verification outcome is returned to the Physics Repair Agent for another targeted refinement.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on Physics-IQ Verified ( Motamed et al., 2025 ; Rädsch et al., 2026 ) , comprising 198 take-1 instances from 66 real-world physical experiments observed from three viewpoints. The benchmark spans solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, optics, thermodynamics, and magnetism. We use the verified physical descriptions and switch frames for generation, with model-specific prompt formatting following the benchmark protocol when available. Reference continuations and evaluator masks are never exposed to PhysRepair or its experience memory and are accessed only during evaluation. We follow the official evaluation protocol and report the aggregate Physics-IQ Verified score. The evaluator additionally measures Spatial IoU, Spatiotemporal IoU, Weighted Spatial IoU, and RGB MSE, which jointly characterize the spatial and temporal agreement between generated videos and physically valid reference dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Physics-IQ Verified（Motamed et al., 2025；Rädsch et al., 2026）上进行评估，该数据集包含来自 66 个真实世界物理实验的 198 个 take-1 实例，这些实验从三个视角进行观测。 该基准涵盖固体力学、流体力学、光学、热学和磁学。 我们使用经核验的物理描述并切换帧用于生成，在可用时按照基准协议采用模型特定的提示词格式。 参考续写内容和评估器掩码从不暴露给 PhysRepair 及其经验记忆，仅在评估期间被访问。 我们遵循官方评估协议并报告 Physics-IQ Verified 的聚合分数。 评估器还测量空间 IoU、时空 IoU、加权空间 IoU 和 RGB MSE，这些指标共同刻画了生成视频与物理上有效的参考动态之间的空间和时间一致性。

paragraphs.en: PhysRepair generates and repairs videos using the frozen MiniMax H3 Ref2VA backbone. Specifically, the initial video is generated using MiniMax H3 FL2VA. GPT-6-Astra performs structured diagnosis, causal planning, verification, and experience distillation. Perception and registration combine SAM 2 ( Ravi et al., 2024 ) with tracking ( Karaev et al., 2025 ) , optical flow ( Lai et al., 2026 ) and depth ( Lin et al., 2025 ) tools, while the diagnosed local interaction is reconstructed and simulated in simulator ( Coumans and Bai, 2016 ; Blender Online Community, 2018 ) . The resulting counterfactual state is converted into generation-compatible structural and motion conditions and injected through the H3 control adapter. The generator uses 20 denoising steps, and the agent performs at most 20 repair rounds, terminating once the physics criteria are satisfied.
paragraphs.zh: PhysRepair 使用冻结的 MiniMax H3 Ref2VA 骨干网络生成并修复视频。 具体而言，初始视频由 MiniMax H3 FL2VA 生成。 GPT-6-Astra 执行结构化诊断、因果规划、验证以及经验蒸馏。 感知与配准将 SAM 2（Ravi et al., 2024）与跟踪（Karaev et al., 2025）、光流（Lai et al., 2026）以及深度（Lin et al., 2025）工具相结合，同时在模拟器（Coumans and Bai, 2016；Blender Online Community, 2018）中对诊断出的局部交互进行重建与仿真。 所得到的反事实状态被转换为与生成兼容的结构和运动条件，并通过 H3 控制适配器注入。 生成器使用 20 个去噪步骤，智能体最多执行 20 轮修复，一旦满足物理判据即终止。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares PhysRepair with general-purpose video generators and physics-aware methods. PhysRepair achieves the highest overall Physics-IQ score of 43.6 among the reported methods, surpassing the strongest video-generation baseline, Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video, by 0.9 points. Compared with MiniMax H3 FL2VA, PhysRepair improves Physics-IQ from 39.8 to 43.6, demonstrating the benefit of targeted physical repair over the initial generation. The improvement is concentrated in the spatiotemporal metrics. In particular, PhysRepair increases ST from 22.8 to 34.7 (+11.9) and WS from 40.5 to 44.2 (+3.7) over MiniMax H3 FL2VA. This pattern is consistent with the design of PhysRepair: rather than globally modifying already-valid visual content, it localizes causally affected states and corrects the corresponding interaction dynamics. The larger gains in ST and WS therefore indicate improved spatiotemporal agreement with physically valid dynamics, while the stable SP and MSE scores suggest that these corrections are achieved without substantially perturbing the original spatial appearance.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 further compares different methods on two contact-driven interactions that require maintaining physical consistency across multiple interacting objects and over time. In the fan–garment example, the generated sequence must preserve the identities of the fan and the hanging garments, establish the direction of the fan-induced airflow, and produce garment motion consistent with the resulting aerodynamic force. Existing methods frequently break this interaction through weak or missing force responses despite visible fan motion (VLIPP, MiniMax H3), physically implausible garment motion (Wan2.2), or garment responses whose motion direction is inconsistent with the fan-induced airflow (Cosmos3-Super). In contrast, PhysRepair preserves the identities of both the fan and the garments and restores the correct force–response dynamics: the fan first generates directed airflow, after which the garments deform and sway in a physically plausible manner consistent with the applied force. This result illustrates how our Spatiotemporal Causal Constraints support targeted correction of causally affected states while preserving valid object states, enabling coherent force-driven dynamics without unnecessary changes to unaffected content.
paragraphs.zh: 图3进一步在两个接触驱动的交互上比较了不同方法，这些交互需要在多个相互作用的物体之间以及随时间推移保持物理一致性。 在风扇–衣物的示例中，生成的序列必须保持风扇和悬挂衣物的身份，确立风扇产生气流的方向，并生成与由此产生的空气动力相一致的衣物运动。 现有方法经常破坏这种交互，表现为尽管风扇运动清晰可见但力的响应微弱或缺失（VLIPP、MiniMax H3）、衣物运动不符合物理规律（Wan2.2），或衣物响应的运动方向与风扇产生的气流不一致（Cosmos3-Super）。 相比之下，PhysRepair 保持了风扇和衣物的身份，并恢复了正确的力–响应动力学：风扇首先产生定向气流，随后衣物以与所施加的力相一致的、符合物理规律的方式发生形变并摆动。 这一结果表明，我们的时空因果约束如何在保持有效物体状态的同时，支持对受因果影响状态的针对性修正，从而实现连贯的力驱动动力学，而无需对未受影响的内容进行不必要的更改。

paragraphs.en: The wrench–box example requires a longer interaction sequence: the wrench falls toward the box, makes contact, and subsequently rebounds. Competing methods often realize only part of this process, e.g., failing to establish effective contact (Wan2.2) or introducing substantial geometry and trajectory inconsistencies (VLIPP). More specifically, MiniMax H3 exhibits a spatiotemporal causal misalignment in which the target box begins moving before the actual collision, together with visible wrench–box interpenetration, whereas Cosmos 3 Super leaves the wrench stalled at the box instead of completing the expected rebound. In contrast, PhysRepair preserves the wrench and box identities while restoring a coherent fall–contact–rebound sequence. This result illustrates how causally constrained, simulation-guided repair can address both incorrect contact timing and subsequent motion inconsistencies while preserving unaffected content. Together, these cases highlight the benefit of identifying causally affected states and guiding their localized regeneration with physically plausible counterfactual dynamics, rather than correcting individual frames or objects in isolation.

paragraphs.en: We conduct a user study in which participants rank videos generated by the compared methods according to their perceived physical consistency. As shown in Fig. 5(b) , PhysRepair achieves the best average rank among all compared methods, indicating that its improvements are also reflected in human judgments of physical plausibility. paragraphs.en: We qualitatively examine how Spatiotemporal Causal Constraints affect localized physical repair. As shown in Fig. 4 , without the causal constraint, the agent can often correct the most salient error on the directly involved object, but may leave causally affected states unresolved or alter valid interactions that should remain fixed. In the goalkeeper example, MiniMax H3 produces a contradictory outcome in which the shot is both saved and scored. Without the causal constraint, the duplicated ball is removed, but a residual ball artifact in the goal and continued net motion still imply a scoring event. The full model additionally corrects these downstream states, yielding a clean save. In the ball-collision example, the source video exhibits an implausible collision between the soccer ball and the blue ball. Removing the causal constraint resolves the collision but disrupts the preceding foot–ball contact, causing the ball to move without a valid kick. In contrast, the full model preserves the valid kick while correcting the subsequent collision dynamics. In the water-leakage example, the source video exhibits spurious water leakage from the upper cup into the basin below, which consequently induces fluid motion in the basin. Without the causal constraint, the leakage itself is corrected, but the resulting motion of the water in the basin remains, leaving a downstream effect without its corresponding cause. In contrast, the full model propagates the correction to these causally dependent states and removes the residual fluid response, restoring a physically consistent interaction. Together, these cases show that causal constraints are important for both propagating corrections to downstream affected states and preserving valid states outside the repair scope, enabling complete yet localized physical repair.
paragraphs.zh: 我们定性地考察了时空因果约束如何影响局部化的物理修复。 如图 4 所示，在没有因果约束的情况下，智能体通常能够纠正直接相关对象上最显著错误，但可能会让受因果影响的状态得不到解决，或改变本应保持不变的有效交互。 在守门员的例子中，MiniMax H3 产生了一个矛盾的结果：射门既被扑出又被打进。 在没有因果约束的情况下，重复的足球被移除了，但球门中残留的足球伪影以及球网持续的晃动仍然暗示存在进球事件。 完整模型还会进一步纠正这些下游状态，从而得到一个干净的扑救。 在足球碰撞的例子中，源视频呈现出足球与蓝球之间一次不合常理的碰撞。 移除因果约束虽然解决了碰撞问题，但破坏了此前脚与球的有效接触，导致足球在没有任何有效踢击的情况下移动。 相比之下，完整模型在保留有效踢击的同时纠正了随后的碰撞动力学。 在漏水的例子中，源视频呈现出上方的杯子向下方水盆中虚假漏水的现象，进而引起了水盆中的流体运动。 在没有因果约束的情况下，漏水本身被纠正了，但水盆中由此产生的水的运动仍然存在，留下了一个没有对应原因的下游效应。 相比之下，完整模型将纠正传播到这些因果依赖的状态，并移除了残余的流体响应，恢复了物理上一致的交互。 总而言之，这些案例表明，因果约束对于将纠正传播到下游受影响的状态以及保留修复范围之外的有效状态都很重要，从而实现完整而局部化的物理修复。

sents.zh: 在没有因果约束的情况下，漏水本身被纠正了，但水盆中由此产生的水的运动仍然存在，留下了一个没有对应原因的下游效应。

sents.en: In contrast, the full model propagates the correction to these causally dependent states and removes the residual fluid response, restoring a physically consistent interaction.
sents.zh: 相比之下，完整模型将纠正传播到这些因果依赖的状态，并移除了残余的流体响应，恢复了物理上一致的交互。

sents.en: Together, these cases show that causal constraints are important for both propagating corrections to downstream affected states and preserving valid states outside the repair scope, enabling complete yet localized physical repair.
sents.zh: 总而言之，这些案例表明，因果约束对于将纠正传播到下游受影响的状态以及保留修复范围之外的有效状态都很重要，从而实现完整而局部化的物理修复。

paragraphs.en: For this analysis, we select 100 cases from the videos initially generated by MiniMax H3 FL2VA, each diagnosed as containing a physical inconsistency. These cases are processed sequentially to examine how repair efficiency evolves as long-term experience memory accumulates. We examine how accumulated cross-sample experience affects iterative repair efficiency. As shown in Fig. 5(a) , the moving average of repair rounds decreases as long-term experience memory grows, despite variation across individual cases. Difficult cases can still exhaust the 20-round budget, but such cases become less frequent as experience accumulates. The results suggest that experience reuse can reduce repeated exploration and improve repair efficiency without updating model weights. This trend is consistent with the intended role of our Experience-Augmented In-Context Learning: combining current repair feedback with relevant prior experience to guide intervention selection and recovery from unsuccessful attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 在本分析中，我们从由 MiniMax H3 FL2VA 最初生成的视频中选取 100 个被诊断为包含物理不一致性的案例。 这些案例按顺序处理，以检验随着长期经验记忆的积累，修复效率如何演变。 我们考察积累的跨样本经验如何影响迭代修复效率。 如图 5(a) 所示，尽管个体案例之间存在差异，但随着长期经验记忆的增长，修复轮数的移动平均值呈下降趋势。 困难案例仍可能耗尽 20 轮的预算，但随着经验的积累，这类案例变得更加少见。 结果表明，经验复用可以在不更新模型权重的情况下减少重复探索并提高修复效率。 这一趋势与我们提出的经验增强上下文学习（Experience-Augmented In-Context Learning）的预期作用一致：将当前修复反馈与相关的先验经验相结合，以指导干预选择并从失败的尝试中恢复。

paragraphs.en: PhysRepair currently relies on a capable multimodal language model as the repair agent for physical diagnosis, tool selection, causal reasoning, verification, and experience reuse. Consequently, its performance is partly bounded by the agent model’s physical reasoning and tool-use capabilities, and weaker agent backbones may lead to less reliable repair decisions. This dependence also introduces additional inference cost compared with one-pass video generation, particularly when multiple repair rounds are required.
paragraphs.zh: PhysRepair 目前依赖一个能力强大的多模态语言模型作为修复智能体，用于物理诊断、工具选择、因果推理、验证和经验复用。 因此，其性能在一定程度上受限于智能体模型的物理推理与工具使用能力，较弱的智能体基座模型可能导致可靠性较低的修复决策。 与一次性视频生成相比，这种依赖还引入了额外的推理成本，尤其是在需要多轮修复的情况下。

paragraphs.en: PhysRepair provides a general mechanism for improving the physical plausibility of generated videos without retraining the underlying video generator, which may benefit applications that require more reliable physical dynamics, such as simulation, embodied AI, and synthetic data generation. At the same time, increasingly realistic physical video generation and repair may make synthetic content more difficult to distinguish from real recordings, potentially increasing risks of deceptive or misleading media. We therefore view provenance mechanisms and responsible deployment practices as important complements to further improvements in physically grounded video generation.
paragraphs.zh: PhysRepair 提供了一种通用机制，可以在不重新训练底层视频生成器的情况下提升生成视频的物理合理性，这可能有益于需要更可靠物理动力学的应用，例如仿真、具身智能和合成数据生成。 与此同时，越来越逼真的物理视频生成与修复可能使合成内容更难与真实录像区分开来，从而可能增加欺骗性或误导性媒体的风险。 因此，我们认为溯源机制和负责任的部署实践是进一步改进基于物理的视频生成的重要补充。

paragraphs.en: We presented PhysRepair, an agentic framework for improving the physical plausibility of generated videos through an iterative generate–diagnose–repair process. Rather than imposing physical guidance entirely before synthesis, PhysRepair diagnoses the realized failure and uses Spatiotemporal Causal Constraints to localize the causally affected states. Under this constraint, the Physics Repair Agent derives a physically admissible counterfactual evolution for the affected interaction, which guides localized repair while preserving unaffected content. Experience-augmented In-context Learning further adapts repair decisions using current-sample feedback and relevant experience from previous repairs. Experiments on Physics-IQ Verified across five physics categories demonstrate consistent improvements in physical plausibility, suggesting post-hoc adaptive repair as a complementary direction for physically grounded video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了PhysRepair，一个通过迭代式生成–诊断–修复过程来提升生成视频物理合理性的智能体框架。 PhysRepair并不完全在合成之前施加物理引导，而是在生成后诊断已发生的失败，并利用时空因果约束来定位受因果影响的状态。 在该约束下，物理修复智能体为受影响的交互推导出物理上可行的反事实演化，从而指导局部修复并保留未受影响的内容。 经验增强的上下文学习进一步利用当前样本的反馈以及来自以往修复的相关经验来调整修复决策。 在Physics-IQ Verified上跨五个物理类别的实验表明，物理合理性获得了一致的提升，这表明事后自适应修复可以作为物理接地视频生成的一个互补方向。
